F01.title: Two Women, Two Men
F01.raw:
Hospital staff exit ke bahar shaam ki halki roshni mein chaaron log ikatthe hue. Aditi white coat ke neeche fitted black shirt aur straight trousers mein khadi thi, baal loosely tied, posture seedha aur nazar confidently aage. Avi dark shirt ke sleeves roll karke uske saamne aaya. Yash thodi doori pe khada tha, expression relaxed. Meenakshi plum kurta, cream palazzo aur grey cardigan mein unke paas pahunchi, keys haath mein.

**Aditi:** “Avi, hospital mein toh bade disciplined rehte ho. Aaj dance floor pe meri pace match kar paoge?”

Avi ne uski nazar se nazar milayi. Woh expected kar raha tha normal baat, lekin Aditi ka tone seedha aur testing tha.

**Avi:** “Tum pace badhaogi toh mujhe bhi apna best dena padega.”

**Aditi:** **“Best dena. Excuses mat dena. Main performance yaad rakhti hoon.”**

Avi pehle jawab dena chaha, lekin Aditi ke steady eye contact ne use ek pal ke liye rok diya. Uske lips pe halki smile aayi, phir gayab ho gayi. Meenakshi ne uska badalta expression notice kiya.

**Yash:** “Meenakshi ma’am, lagta hai Avi ko aaj extra training chahiye.”

**Meenakshi:** **“Training se zyada concentration. Aditi abhi warm-up mein hai aur yeh already nervous hai.”**

Aditi hasli, achha laga. Avi ne Meenakshi ki taraf dekha — ab use samajh aa gaya tha ki aaj teasing sirf ek taraf se nahi hone wali.

**Aditi:** “Nervous mat samajhna. Main sirf dekh rahi hoon kaun kitna der tak saath de sakta hai.”

**Avi:** “Dekh lena. Main aaj sirf dekhne nahi aaya.”

Yash ne dono ke beech ki nazar ka exchange dekha aur dheere se bola.

**Yash:** “Aditi, tum toh already floor set kar rahi ho. Hum log abhi sirf audience hain.”

**Aditi:** “Audience nahi. Participants. Meenakshi drive kar rahi hain. Tum dono peeche baithna… taaki main aage se tumhe dekh sakun.”

Meenakshi ne keys uthayi aur group ki taraf ishara kiya.

**Meenakshi:** “Chalo. Parking door hai. Zyada der mat lagao.”

Aditi ne Avi ki taraf ek last, deliberate look diya aur pehle kadam badhaya. Avi uske peeche chala, lekin ab uski chaal pehle jaisi relaxed nahi thi. Yash ne Meenakshi ke saath side se chalna shuru kiya.

**Yash:** “Aaj Aditi ne already apna plan clear kar diya hai.”

**Meenakshi:** “Plan clear hai. Ab dekhna yeh hai kaun uske saath chal paata hai.”

Chaaron log parking ki taraf badhe. Aditi aage thi, walk mein wohi confidence jo usne abhi Avi ko challenge karte hue dikhaya tha. Avi uske peeche tha, mann mein ab sirf ek baat ghoom rahi thi — aaj dance floor pe Aditi usse sirf mazaak nahi karegi.

F02.title: Meenakshi Offers the Ride
F02.source: Author-submitted latest revised Grok F02 (NOT assistant-written alternative)
F02.raw:
Meenakshi ne parking mein ruk ke group ki taraf dekha.

**Meenakshi:** “Main apni car le aayi hoon. Main drive karungi. Chalo.”

Aditi bina der kiye front passenger seat pe baith gayi. Avi aur Yash peeche settle hue. Meenakshi ne engine start kiya aur car dheere se bahar nikal gayi.

**Aditi:** “Avi, aaj dance floor pe tumhe kis ke saath shuru karna hai? Ya main already decide kar loon?”

Avi ne uski taraf dekha, tone confident.

**Avi:** “Tum decide kar lo. Main refuse nahi karunga.”

**Aditi:** **“Theek hai. Pehli dance meri hogi. Tum sirf haath dena… aur dekhna main kitni der tak tumhe apne pace pe rakhti hoon.”**

Avi hasa, lekin uski aankhon mein ab interest clearly dikh raha tha.

**Yash:** “Aditi, tumne Avi ko already select kar liya. Main line mein hoon ya wait karun?”

**Aditi:** “Line mein ho. Lekin agar tum slow ho gaye toh main tumhe skip bhi kar sakti hoon.”

Yash ne yeh sun ke seedha Avi ki taraf dekha. Usse ab clear ho gaya tha ki aaj sirf Avi hi nahi, woh bhi Aditi ke attention ke liye compete kar raha hai.

Meenakshi steering pe haath rakhe road dekh rahi thi. Uske lips pe halki smile thi.

**Meenakshi:** **“Aditi, tum peeche baithe logon ko already dance floor pe khada kar rahi ho. Gaadi abhi road pe hai.”**

**Aditi:** “Meenakshi, main sirf unhe ready kar rahi hoon. Tum drive karo. Main baaki ka kaam farmhouse pe kar lungi.”

Avi ne peeche se Aditi ki taraf dekha. Woh ab pehle jaisa relaxed nahi tha. Uske mann mein ek clear soch aa chuki thi — Aditi ne usse pehli dance ka invitation de diya hai, aur woh usse miss nahi karna chahta.

**Yash:** “Avi, lagta hai aaj tumhe competition mil gaya hai.”

**Avi:** “Competition theek hai. Main pehle se ready hoon.”

Car aage badhti rahi. Aditi front seat pe baithi thi, professional outfit mein, lekin uska tone aur nazar peeche baithe dono logon ko clearly involve kar rahi thi. Meenakshi ne mirror mein unki expressions ek baar dekhi, phir wapas road pe focus kiya. Usko unki baatein sun ke maza aa raha tha, lekin woh driving se nahi hati.

Avi peeche baitha tha, lekin ab uski nazar baar baar Aditi pe ja rahi thi. Yash uske bagal mein khamosh tha, lekin uske chehre pe ab pehle se zyada alertness thi. Group farmhouse ki taraf badh raha tha, aur teeno ke beech ki chemistry ab pehle se alag lag rahi thi.

F03.title: The One-Glass Challenge
F03.raw:
Farmhouse ke open area mein halki string lights jal rahi thin. Aditi ne car se utarte hi group ko seedha seating ki taraf le gayi. Woh abhi bhi professional outfit mein thi — white coat hataya hua, black shirt aur trousers. Meenakshi plum kurta, cream palazzo aur grey cardigan mein uske peeche chali.

**Aditi:** “Aao. Drinks yahan hain. Music ready hai. Guest room bhi available hai agar kisi ko change karna ho.”

Usne table pe wine aur juice ke glasses set kiye. Avi aur Yash sofe pe baith gaye. Meenakshi thodi doori pe khadi rahi.

**Meenakshi:** “Mujhe juice de do. Wine nahi.”

**Aditi:** “Juice theek hai. Lekin ek chhoti si baat. Aaj raat ke liye ek simple rule rakhte hain — ek glass, ek honest answer. Jo bhi pehle glass le, usse ek seedha sawal ka jawab dena hoga. Baaki log sirf sunenge.”

Meenakshi ne Aditi ki taraf dekha.

**Meenakshi:** “Yeh rule tumne abhi socha hai, ya pehle se plan tha?”

**Aditi:** **“Abhi socha. Kyunki tumne juice maanga. Main dekhna chahti hoon tum hum sab ko kitna closely dekh rahi ho.”**

Avi hasa. Yash ne glass uthaya lekin peena nahi.

**Aditi:** “Toh pehla sawal. Hospital mein kaun sabse behtar hai is baat mein ki woh notice nahi kar raha… jab koi usse zyada dekh raha ho?”

Avi ne seedha jawab diya.

**Avi:** “Yeh toh easy hai. Yash. Woh hamesha side se dekhte rehte hain.”

**Yash:** “Main side se dekh raha hoon ya tum openly baat kar rahe ho, yeh alag baat hai. Meenakshi ma’am, aap kya kehti hain?”

Meenakshi ne thodi der socha, phir calmly kaha.

**Meenakshi:** **“Dono alag hain. Ek openly flirt karta hai taaki doosra notice kare. Doosra quietly dekhta hai taaki pehla uncomfortable na ho. Farq yeh hai ki pehla jaanta hai usse dekha ja raha hai. Doosra sochta hai koi nahi dekh raha.”**

Avi ki smile thodi kam hui. Usse samajh aa gaya Meenakshi uski taraf ishara kar rahi hai. Yash ne glass table pe rakh diya. Usko bhi clear ho gaya ki Meenakshi uske quiet watching ko bhi catch kar chuki hai.

**Aditi:** “Achha answer. Matlab tum dono ko pehle se dekh rahi thi.”

**Meenakshi:** “Main doctor hoon. Logon ko observe karna meri aadat hai. Farmhouse pe bhi wahi kaam karti hoon.”

Aditi hasli. Usne ek glass wine uthaya aur Meenakshi ki taraf badhaya.

**Aditi:** “Ab tum decide karo. Juice pe rehna hai ya ek glass leke is game mein aana hai. Koi pressure nahi.”

Meenakshi ne glass dekha, phir Aditi ki nazar. Thodi der baad usne glass le liya.

**Meenakshi:** “Ek glass. Sirf isliye kyunki tumne sawal poochha. Ab main bhi sunna chahti hoon tum log kya sochte ho.”

Avi ne apna glass uthaya. Yash ne bhi. Teeno ne ek-ek sip liya. Meenakshi ne apna glass haath mein rakha, peena abhi nahi shuru kiya.

**Yash:** “Ma’am, aapne toh humein already expose kar diya.”

**Meenakshi:** “Expose nahi kiya. Sirf bataya ki main dekh rahi thi. Ab tum log bhi dekh lo.”

Aditi ne group ko dekha. Usko maza aa raha tha. Usne apna glass table pe rakha aur seedha kaha.

**Aditi:** “Main thodi der ke liye guest room ja rahi hoon. Change karke aati hoon. Tum log settle ho jao. Music on hai.”

Woh guest room ki taraf badhi, professional outfit abhi bhi pehne hue. Avi uske jaate hue dekhta raha. Yash ne Meenakshi ki taraf dekha — uske haath mein ab wine ka glass tha, lekin uski nazar ab bhi group pe thi. Meenakshi ne ek chhota sip liya aur sofe pe baith gayi. Farmhouse mein ab sirf teeno log the, aur Aditi ke wapas aane ka intezaar.

F04.title: Aditi Sets the Temperature
F04.source: Author-submitted Grok F04; editorially corrected approved alternative exists separately
F04.raw:
Guest room se Aditi bahar aayi. Warm string lights uske burgundy mini-dress pe pad rahi thin. Thin straps uske shoulders pe the, deep neckline collarbones se neeche tak clearly dikh raha tha. Short hem mid-thigh ke upar tha. Jaise hi woh seating ki taraf badhi, dress ka satin fabric uske steps ke saath uski thighs pe shift hua, hem thoda sa upar uth ke wapas settle hua.

Avi ne glass table pe rakh diya. Uski nazar pehle neckline pe ruki, phir waist pe, phir legs pe.

**Avi:** **“Aditi… yeh dress tum pe jaan-bujh ke fit kiya hua lag raha hai. Neckline se lekar hem tak, har movement dikh rahi hai.”**

Aditi ne walk slow rakha. Ek haath wine glass ke saath, doosra side mein. Usko pata tha nazar kahan ja rahi hai.

**Aditi:** “Jaan-bujh ke hi pehna hai. Aaj professional look nahi chahiye tha.”

Yash ne uske shoulders aur open hair pe nazar rakhi.

**Yash:** “Hairstyle change kiya. Pehle tied thi. Ab face aur neckline dono zyada clear hain.”

**Aditi:** “Notice kiya. Achha hai.”

Meenakshi sofe pe baithi thi. Usne Aditi ko junior resident se is glamorous hostess mein badalte dekha — fitted silhouette, confident walk, short hem ke movement. Kuch nahi kaha.

Aditi unke beech mein aayi, hips ka natural sway dress ke saath clearly dikh raha tha. Avi ab bhi usko dekh raha tha. Yash ne glass uthaya lekin nazar nahi hatayi.

**Aditi:** “Music chal raha hai. Main dance shuru karti hoon. Jo join karna chahe, aa sakta hai.”

Usne Avi ki taraf dekha. Short hem uske last step pe thoda sa upar hua. Farmhouse ki lighting ab uske body pe alag lag rahi thi. Atmosphere change ho chuka tha.
